key_provisions_or_claims: Ethics Guideline sets procedures for determining, applying, monitoring and evaluating AI ethics in Ministry of National Education activities.
Teachers and Ministry units must complete an online Ethics Declaration Form via the YAZEK system for AI applications.
Establishes a Higher Ethics Board, provincial and district AI ethics boards, and school AI ethics teams.
Covers ethical violation reporting, recording, evaluation and monitoring processes.
YAZEK system opens 2 February 2026; guideline follows the 2025-2029 AI in Education Policy Document and Action Plan.
annotation.summary_en: Turkish Ministry of National Education announcement that it has published the Ethics Guideline for AI Applications in Education. It describes ethics boards at national, provincial, district and school levels, a mandatory online ethics declaration via the YAZEK system from 2 February 2026, and ethical violation reporting procedures.
